model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for per-specialty terms across various fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis lists six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled with values ranging from -27 to -22, marked at intervals of 1, on a linear scale. Each category on the horizontal axis contains six grouped bars, corresponding to the Mistralv0.2-Base model fine-tuned on Cardio (light blue), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The grouped bars within each specialty term category vary slightly in height; the bars for Cardio fine-tuned on Cardio, Infect, and Neuro are approximately -26.2, -25.5, and -25.75 respectively, while the bar for Pediatrics fine-tuned on Pediatrics is around -23.6; no bars are visually emphasized or sorted in a specific order beyond their grouping by fine-tuned model.
